mutations.name: name-limit-129
mutations.what: a name of 129 characters is accepted

mutations.name: text-limit-2049
mutations.what: the text limit is one byte larger

mutations.name: schema-depth-33
mutations.what: a schema one level deeper is accepted

mutations.name: schema-bytes-plus-one
mutations.what: a schema one byte larger than 64 KB is accepted

mutations.name: no-format-characters
mutations.what: format characters that are not Default_Ignorable (U+FFF9 ...) are kept

mutations.name: no-default-ignorable
mutations.what: Default_Ignorable code points that are not Cf (U+2065, U+FFF0, U+E0080, the fillers, the variation selectors) are kept

mutations.name: no-lone-surrogates
mutations.what: lone surrogates are kept

mutations.name: no-control-characters
mutations.what: control characters (C0, DEL, C1) are kept

mutations.name: newline-removed
mutations.what: a newline counts as hidden

mutations.name: tab-removed
mutations.what: a tab counts as hidden

mutations.name: crlf-counted
mutations.what: the CR of a CRLF counts as a removed character (a marker for every Windows line end)

mutations.name: astral-counted-twice
mutations.what: a removed astral character (a tag) counts as two

mutations.name: pair-split
mutations.what: the cut can fall between the halves of a surrogate pair

mutations.name: two-byte-as-one
mutations.what: a two-byte character is counted as one byte

mutations.name: fit-off-by-one
mutations.what: a character that fits exactly is left out

mutations.name: marker-reserve-without-space
mutations.what: the room kept for the marker forgets the space before it

mutations.name: second-pass-full-budget
mutations.what: the text is not cut again to make room for the marker

mutations.name: removal-without-marker
mutations.what: a text that was only cleaned gets no marker

mutations.name: single-removal-unmarked
mutations.what: one removed character is not mentioned

mutations.name: marker-alone-with-space
mutations.what: a text that was all hidden characters becomes a space and the marker

mutations.name: min-limit-127
mutations.what: a text limit of 127 bytes is accepted

mutations.name: name-space-allowed
mutations.what: a space is allowed in a name

mutations.name: name-not-anchored
mutations.what: the name pattern only has to match the end

mutations.name: constructor-allowed
mutations.what: the name constructor is accepted

mutations.name: name-limit-option-wide
mutations.what: a name limit of 100,000 is accepted

mutations.name: preview-raw-unicode
mutations.what: the preview shows a zero-width character as it is

mutations.name: depth-plus-one
mutations.what: the depth check lets one more level through

patches.old: if (depth > state.maxDepth) throw new Stop('too_deep', path);
patches.new: if (depth > state.maxDepth + 1) throw new Stop('too_deep', path);

mutations.name: any-prototype
mutations.what: objects of any class (Date, Map ...) are walked as plain JSON

patches.old: if (prototype !== Object.prototype && prototype !== null) throw new Stop('not_json', path);

mutations.name: infinity-allowed
mutations.what: Infinity passes as a number

mutations.name: minus-zero-kept
mutations.what: -0 is copied as -0 instead of the 0 of JSON

mutations.name: comma-not-counted
mutations.what: the comma between keys is not counted in the size

mutations.name: proto-key-allowed
mutations.what: a __proto__ key is accepted in a schema

mutations.name: hidden-key-allowed
mutations.what: a schema key may hide characters

mutations.name: title-not-cleaned
mutations.what: a title inside a schema is not cleaned

mutations.name: hidden-value-allowed
mutations.what: a schema value (an enum member) may hide characters

mutations.name: remote-ref-allowed
mutations.what: a reference may point to another document

mutations.name: any-schema-type
mutations.what: a schema of any type is accepted at the top

mutations.name: hint-any-type
mutations.what: an annotation hint that is not a boolean passes

mutations.name: hint-inherited
mutations.what: an inherited hint (a polluted Object.prototype) is read

mutations.name: annotations-dropped-uncapped
mutations.what: every dropped annotation key is named

mutations.name: own-inherited
mutations.what: fields are read through the prototype chain

patches.old: const own = (object, key) => (Object.hasOwn(object, key) ? object[key] : undefined);

mutations.name: cut-only-unnoted
mutations.what: a text that was only cut gets no note

mutations.name: argument-description-undefined
mutations.what: an argument without a description has description undefined

mutations.name: required-truthy
mutations.what: any truthy value makes an argument required

mutations.name: arguments-64-refused
mutations.what: a prompt with exactly 64 arguments is refused

mutations.name: argument-duplicates
mutations.what: two arguments of one name are accepted

mutations.name: uri-space-allowed
mutations.what: a URI may contain a space

mutations.name: uri-2049
mutations.what: a URI of 2049 bytes is accepted

patches.old: if (uri.length > LIMITS.uriMaxBytes || utf8(uri) > LIMITS.uriMaxBytes) return refuseUri('uri_too_long');
patches.new: if (uri.length > LIMITS.uriMaxBytes + 1 || utf8(uri) > LIMITS.uriMaxBytes + 1) return refuseUri('uri_too_long');

mutations.name: resource-name-2k
mutations.what: a resource name is cut at 2 KB instead of 256 bytes

mutations.name: list-duplicates
mutations.what: two tools of one name are both kept

mutations.name: list-no-cap
mutations.what: every item of a list is read

mutations.name: refusals-uncapped
mutations.what: every refusal is listed

mutations.name: strip-counts-runs
mutations.what: stripHidden counts runs instead of characters

mutations.name: cut-fast-path-units
mutations.what: cutToBytes compares UTF-16 units with bytes

patches.old: if (text.length * 3 <= maxBytes || utf8(text) <= maxBytes) return text;

mutations.name: line-breaks-kept
mutations.what: U+2028 and U+2029 are kept in a description

patches.old: .slice(position, end - position > room ? position + room + 1 : end).replace(LINE_BREAKS, '\n');
patches.new: .slice(position, end - position > room ? position + room + 1 : end);

mutations.name: line-breaks-removed
mutations.what: U+2028 and U+2029 are removed instead of becoming a newline

patches.old: .slice(position, end - position > room ? position + room + 1 : end).replace(LINE_BREAKS, '\n');
patches.new: .slice(position, end - position > room ? position + room + 1 : end).replace(LINE_BREAKS, '');

mutations.name: paragraph-separator-kept
mutations.what: U+2029 is kept

mutations.name: strip-line-breaks-kept
mutations.what: stripHidden keeps U+2028 and U+2029

mutations.name: dynamic-ref-allowed
mutations.what: a remote $dynamicRef is accepted

mutations.name: recursive-ref-allowed
mutations.what: a remote $recursiveRef is accepted

mutations.name: remote-id-allowed
mutations.what: an absolute $id is accepted

mutations.name: id-network-path-allowed
mutations.what: an $id that starts with // is accepted

mutations.name: id-relative-refused
mutations.what: a relative $id is refused too
